newsitem.title: USA: Boulder police to return to JonBenet's home.
newsitem.headline: Boulder police to return to JonBenet's home.

text.p: Six months into the investigation into the murder of 6-year-old JonBenet Ramsey police plan to return to the home where her body was found to continue their probe, officials said Tuesday.
"The primary purpose is to develop an architectural model of the home to assist in the investigation and presentation of the case," Boulder police said in a short statement.
Police also said the beauty pageant winner's parents, Jon and Patricia Ramsey, agreed to let the police enter the home and that a search warrant was not necessary.
A report from the Colorado Bureau of Investigation on its analysis of a fifth handwriting sample provided by Patricia Ramsey, was not complete, police reported..
The body of the tiny winner of child beauty pageants was found Dec. 26 by her father in the family home after the mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
No arrests have been made. The Ramsey family was spending the summer at their home in Michigan.
